facts.text: Begin with Rustic Roots breakfast, then visit Shelburne Museum’s duck decoy collection and Impressionist art, stroll the 1,400‑acre Shelburne Farms, and end with local wine or craft beer.
The most popular local attractions are the Shelburne Farms, Shelburne Museum and Vermont Teddy Bear Factory.
Spend an afternoon at Shelburne Museum, the largest art and history museum in northern New England.
A local paper suggests a day with Le Marché Café breakfast, Shelburne Museum exhibits, Shelburne Vineyard tasting, and craft beer at Folino's and Fiddlehead Brewing.
Discover historic attractions, farm‑to‑table dining, award‑winning cultural institutions, outdoor recreation on Lake Champlain, local artisan shopping, and seasonal events.
The name 'Shelburne' or 'Shelburn' was chosen to honor William Petty, 2nd Earl of Shelburne, a celebrated nobleman of the British parliament and Prime Minister.
